rules.statement: Each APB transfer must become exactly one TL-UL request, and the TL-UL response must become the APB completion.
The TL-UL request must be launched from flip-flops in the first APB access cycle (early launch).
Every output that changes toward either bus must come directly from a flip-flop.
The bridge does not support partial writes (PSTRB other than 4'b1111), byte or half-word accesses, TL-UL bursts, or multiple outstanding requests.
An APB4 full-strobe write must be converted to a TL-UL PutFullData request.
An APB4 read must be converted to a TL-UL Get request.
The bridge must give a local error response for an unsupported strobe or misaligned address.
The bridge must check the TL-UL response and map errors to PSLVERR.
The bridge must support back-to-back APB transfers with PSEL held high.
